name: cetra
oneLine: Open-source LLM observability and evaluation that runs as one binary on one machine, or in cetra Cloud.

selfHostStack.value: One binary and one data folder; S3-compatible storage optional

selfHostLicence.value: MIT core; single sign-on, project roles, audit logs and SCIM need a licence key (Elastic License 2.0)
selfHostLicence.short: MIT core; SSO/SCIM need a licence

cloudFree.value: 100,000 spans and scores a month, 30 days of history, 1 seat

cloudPaidFrom.value: $30 a month for 200,000 spans and scores, then $4 per 100,000

otel.value: OTLP over HTTP and gRPC; reads OpenTelemetry GenAI and OpenInference attributes

sql.value: SQL console in the UI, plus SQL over the API and MCP

mcp.value: MCP server over streamable HTTP: traces, spans, SQL, prompts and issues

onlineEvals.value: LLM judges and checks on live traces, with a filter, sampling and a spending cap
onlineEvals.short: LLM judges and checks, spend cap

datasetsExperiments.value: Versioned datasets; experiments run from the Python and TypeScript SDKs

promptManagement.value: Versioned prompts with labels, SDK fetch with a cache and a fallback, and a playground

alerts.value: Error rate, cost, latency, scores and issue occurrences, to Slack, email or a signed webhook

issueDetection.value: Errors grouped by fingerprint; bad scores, feedback and topics clustered on your LLM connection

annotationQueues.value: Queues of traces, spans or sessions, with instructions, score forms and a lease per reviewer

assistant.value: Chat in the UI on your own LLM connection; drafts filters, SQL, dashboards and evaluators
assistant.short: Chat on your own LLM connection

codingAgents.value: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Qwen Code, Pi, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Goose and Oh My Pi via cetra agents setup

notes: cetra's own facts, sourced to its docs. Sources starting with / are pages of cetra.sh. Updated 2026-11-22: prompt management and MCP rows corrected; issue detection, annotation queues, assistant and coding-agent rows added from the docs pages. Updated 2026-11-23: the licence row adds audit logs and SCIM, from plans-and-licence.
